title: Reassociation of the native constant inverse-image comparison
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed category B with functorial flat resolutions, f:X -> Y and M:B, singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso B f.hom at the constant sheaf M followed by single of upperStarConstantSheafIso B f.hom at M equals leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso B f M.hom.

proof.text: Expand the single-degree left-derived comparison to its exact-derived and exact single-degree factors. The native constant comparison is the same three factors with the other parentheses. Associativity proves the equality.

proof_origin.place: Reassociation of the native constant inverse-image comparison in the first-coordinate constant-object normalization.

from.place: The constant-object unit normalization in the first triangle.

mathlib_searches.query: Derived pullback of a constant sheaf at the monoidal unit agrees with the monoidal unit comparison
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits for sheaf-module pullback of units and cartesian-monoidal sheafToPresheaf. No equality for these concrete unbounded etale constant comparisons.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact match; reuse the source library and functor laws.

mathlib_searches.results: Found CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.Basic, plus unrelated monad and module-presheaf lemmas.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic identity preservation supplies the elementary normalization.

mathlib_searches.results: Nine hits for constantSheafAdj counits and condensed discrete constants; no native derived single-degree comparison formula.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeConstant_hom
    (B : Type uB) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B]
    [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : B) :
    (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso B f).hom.app
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B).obj M) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso B f).hom.app M) =
    (leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso B f M).hom
